title: Video by dacostamotion
description:
Motion Design for Fonzi AI 🚨

@socoloff_alex reached out to me to help bring Fonzi AI’s new brand identity to life through motion.

I worked on the motion direction for the launch, including the animation of the characters and different elements of the new visual identity.

I’ll share a little bit of the process and some of the details behind the animations in this post.

Motion Design: @dacostamotion
